added.summary: `<Scroll>` scrolls. Its children move with the wheel (notches stay on one list while they keep coming), with a finger dragged past 8 px on a touch screen (flinging on when let go while moving), and with keyboard or pad focus, which scrolls the focused control into view. Its children are clipped to its box. A finger held still for 0.5 s fires `onLongPress`. A `hold` prop (seconds) makes a control press only once a press or `confirm` has been held that long: `onHold` reports the progress in `value` each frame, "1" when it completes and "0" when it lets go early. An `autofocus` control takes the focus as it shows, with the focus ring for a pad player. Pointer events carry the box of the node that hears them in `value` ("x y width height"), so a slider maps a drag to its own track.
